purpose: Test whether frozen B1a exact-500m descriptive signal persists at a third 500m venue after Omiya and Kochi.

target.meeting: 大谷石文化日本遺産・デイリー杯

selection_basis: A retrievable standard 12-race FI first-day at the third verified exact-500m venue, Utsunomiya. All 12 races are locked; no result-based race selection is allowed.
blindness_note: R1 historical winner was exposed by search discovery before preregistration. Model was already frozen and all 12 races are locked; this is descriptive robustness only, not blinded confirmatory evidence.
